notes.title: SUPRACORE Early Acces V2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
This update is introducing even more QoL changes to make the game as easy to play and understand as possible!
Also, thank you for playing the game and providing amazing feedback! It really helps me a lot in the process of making the game a great experience!


[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added a tab where you can see what powerups you have unlocked so far and what they do. 
[*] Added the option to select items using the keys 1->9
[*] Made it so you can go back through the UI by using on-screen buttons (you can still use ESC for that)
[*] You can now decrease or increase the speed of the wave by using your keyboard. Q (decrease speed), E (increase speed) and SPACE BAR (pause/unpause the wave)
[*] Added the option to disable the moving border that displays the limits of the buildable area since some players reported getting motion sickness because of it.
[/olist]

notes.title: SUPRACORE Early Access (v0.1) Release
notes.notes:
SUPRACORE is now out in early access!

Get the game now at 30% off!

Join our Discord server for the latest news!
https://discord.gg/D2T9sdt33S


[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
“I feel like the game is in a playable state and most of the features are implemented, but I think that there is still a lot of work to do regarding the balancing which is a really, really important aspect of the game as it can make or break a run. I would like to gather as much information as possible about the current state of the game from the players, and keep a close relation with them to make the game as enjoyable as possible to a wide rage of people.”

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b]
“The game will be in Early Access for at least 2 months”

[b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b]
“I would like to add many more towers, powerups and enemies while making sure that any bug that is encountered by a player is going to be fixed as soon as possible.”

[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]
“The game can be considered "done" if you exclude the limited amount of content.”

[b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b]
“The price will increase accordingly to the content that will be added to the game by that time.”

[b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b]
“I will take into consideration all of the feedback that I receive through any mean of communication (Discord, e-mail, twitter, Steam, etc) and plan the development of the game accordingly.
If any player (even non-player) has an interesting tower/powerup idea that fits the game and the vision that I have for it, I am going to try my best to implement it in the best way possible!”

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to the second devlog for SUPRACORE!

Many things have changed in the past months, mostly "under the hood" stuff that made it so the game functions correctly and it is playable.
Most of the systems of the game were reworked, further improving performance and making the development of the game easier and faster.

A few of the most important things that have been added in this update are:
[olist]
[*]The shop, which can be used to buy towers
[*]Research station, which can be used before each run to unlock new towers
[*]The ability to buy "plots" to expand the base
[*]Powerups that are awarded to the player after every successful wave.
[/olist]

There is also going to be a demo of the game which will be available until the release on 17.03.2023
You can also join our community on discord!
( https://discord.gg/JX8mm5Umqm )

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Welcome everyone!
This is the first devlog on the development of SUPRACORE.
In these "devlog" posts I will be documenting the development of the game and showcase the latest additions to the game, so let's get started!

[h2]1. The main goal of the update[/h2]
In this update I really tried to make the systems behind every object in the game as optimized, modular and efficient as possible to allow for faster development in the future. This makes it really easy to add new resources to the game, modify existent objects with only a few clicks and add new structures easily.

[h2]2. New objects[/h2]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Flamethrower[/b][/u] 
It is a turret that uses [i]Fuel[/i] and [i]Power[/i] to set enemies on fire and deal a large amount of damage in a cone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125329/8bf7f50100e79c7df9b81347b268929955439d70.gif[/img]
[*] [b][u]Mortar[/u][/b]
It uses a large amount of [i]Power[/i] to launch bullets that explode on impact and deal a lot of damage to multiple enemies
This tower has a [b][u]maximum[/u][/b] range [b]AND[/b] a [b][u]minimum[/u][/b] range where it can shoot in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125329/10d543535be2a73c48908ca2eb65ac39168c538b.gif[/img]
[*] [b][u]Ice spreader[/u][/b]
This tower uses power to damage and slow enemies in a small range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125329/b71e66dfa8fbac629422b14a1a86b37e481fc169.gif[/img]
[*] [b][u]Storage units[/u][/b]
They will allow you to store more resources. 
They come in 3 variants:[olist]
[*][b][u]Raw material[/u][/b]
[*][b][u]Liquids[/u][/b]
[*][b][u]Power[/u][/b][/olist][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125329/81b2b0209d4c620a690349a435a24f0440d857c5.png[/img]
[*][b][u]Mixers[/u][/b]
It uses multiple resources to generate a new one (the one shown in the icon in the middle)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125329/d3f6be463b0f98f50459ed7825dbeb44d096d5be.gif[/img]
[*][b][u]Oil pump[/u][/b]
It uses power to extract [i]Oil[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125329/24b3af6b08946b8ee138e09f250b847782e0f914.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]3. UI improvements[/h2]
The "STATS" panel for each object has been improved, showing you what resources it uses, what resources it generates by using icons (not just text as it was previously) alongside useful information about the tower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44125329/55a2f1feef038e647ed3e5bd4ef82a634b6f8f98.png[/img]

More details in the YouTube devlog!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H9X6aud1ibM
